description: This file implements module replication for data parallelism in PyTorch, including functions to check module types, initialize script modules, verify if modules are replicatable, and perform the replication process across devices.

methods.name: _is_script_module
methods.description: Checks if a module is a TorchScript ScriptModule.

methods.name: _is_script_method
methods.description: Checks if an object is a TorchScript ScriptMethod.

methods.name: _init_script_module
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new ScriptModule.

methods.name: _replicatable_module
methods.description: Determines if a module can be safely replicated, considering ScriptModules and their descendants.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Replicates a given neural network module across multiple devices for data parallelism.
